title: That will be a great race tomorrow in Germany. The Gordon Bennett
html_source: The Gordon Bennett was a motorcar race established in Europe by an American millionaire. The 1903 Gordon Bennett Cup was the first international motor race held in Ireland. The 1904 race held June 17th covered 342 miles (4 laps) in the neighborhood of Homburg, Germany. The winner covered the course in 5 h 50 min 3 s, with an average speed of 58.62 mph. (Top speed in practice was reported to be 93 mph in one section.)
